sections.basis: taxable income, unmarried individuals (other than surviving spouses and heads of households)
sections.note: Applied in the CNMI through the Northern Marianas Territorial Income Tax (NMTIT): 4 CMC § 1701 adopts the US Internal Revenue Code as a local territorial income tax, § 1702(c) adopts all future amendments and § 1702(d)(2) makes US revenue procedures authoritative, so the 2026 amounts of Rev. Proc. 2025-32 are the NMTIT amounts. The return (Form 1040CM) is filed with the CNMI Division of Revenue and Taxation, and the tax on CNMI-source income is reduced by the wage and salary tax credit and the rebate of 4 CMC § 1708.

Proc. 2025-32 are the NMTIT amounts. sections.basis: monthly wages; the rate of the bracket applies to the whole payment; the employer also withholds the NMTIT (IRS Pub. 15-T) less the wage and salary tax withheld

sections.title: Earnings tax (Chapter 2): gains, half of real property gains and rents, winnings

sections.title: Social insurance contributions

rows.label: Social security (US FICA): employee
rows.note: wages up to the social security wage base (US federal FICA; Publication 15 is used by employers in the US territories).

rows.label: Social security (US FICA): employer
rows.note: wages up to the social security wage base (US federal FICA, applies in Guam).

rows.label: Social security (US FICA): wage base limit
rows.note: maximum wages subject to the social security tax.

rows.label: Medicare (US FICA): employee
rows.note: all covered wages, no wage base limit (US federal Medicare tax).

rows.label: Medicare (US FICA): employer
rows.note: all covered wages, no wage base limit (US federal Medicare tax).

rows.label: Additional Medicare Tax: employee, wages over $200,000
rows.note: wages paid to an employee in excess of $200,000 in a calendar year (employee only).

rows.label: Federal unemployment tax (FUTA): does not apply
rows.note: federal unemployment tax (FUTA).

sections.note: Employee and employer shares, contribution floors and caps; each row says who pays and on what base.

sections.title: Wage and salary tax (Chapter 2): rate on total yearly wages

source.title: 4 CMC § 1204, Amount of Tax (wage and salary tax and earnings tax)

sections.basis: total yearly wages and salaries for work in the CNMI (Chapter 2 tax); the rate of the bracket applies to the whole amount ("of the amount over $0"), not marginally
sections.note: The wage and salary tax is a nonrefundable credit against the NMTIT on CNMI-source income (Form 1040CM Schedule OS-3405A, Part A; withholding guidelines). The education tax credit (cash contributions to CNMI educational institutions, at most $5,000) reduces it.

rows.label: Minimum wage (Northern Mariana Islands)
rows.note: basic minimum rate in the Northern Mariana Islands (the federal minimum wage). Unit: per hour.

rows.label: Corporate income tax: NMTIT (mirror code) with the CNMI rebate
rows.value: Corporations pay the NMTIT (the US Internal Revenue Code adopted as a local territorial income tax, including its corporate rates) on Form 1120CM, with the rebate offset of 4 CMC § 1708 on CNMI-source income

sections.title: Business gross revenue tax: general business
sections.basis: yearly total gross revenue of a business (general business); the bracket's rate applies to the whole gross revenue ("of the amount over $0"), filed monthly on Form OS-3105
sections.note: The business gross revenue tax is a nonrefundable credit against the owner's NMTIT on CNMI-source income (Schedule OS-3405A). Manufacturers and wholesalers, and agriculture, fishing and registered artists, have their own schedules (4 CMC §§ 1302, 1303).

sections.title: Business gross revenue tax: manufacturers and wholesalers

source.title: 4 CMC § 1303, Tax on Manufacturers and Wholesalers

sections.basis: yearly total gross revenue of manufacturers and wholesalers; the bracket's rate applies to the whole gross revenue

sections.title: Business gross revenue tax: agriculture, fishing and registered artists

source.title: 4 CMC § 1302, Tax on Agriculture Producers and Fishing

sections.basis: yearly total gross revenue of registered artists and of agricultural producers and fishers for dietary consumption: 1% of gross revenue above $20,000

rows.label: Excise tax: all other goods
rows.note: first sale, use, manufacture, lease or rental in the CNMI of goods not otherwise provided for (ad valorem), collected on imports.

rows.label: Excise tax: foodstuffs and other 1% goods
rows.note: foodstuffs, ad valorem (also agricultural inputs, hygiene products, prescription drugs and goods made in the CNMI at 1%).

rows.label: Excise tax: passenger vehicles up to $30,000
rows.note: passenger vehicle with a value not exceeding $30,000 per unit (5.75% above $30,000).

rows.label: Excise tax: cosmetics
rows.note: cosmetics, ad valorem (perfumery 23%; leather goods, jewellery and precious metals 5.75%; construction materials 3%).

rows.label: Excise tax: cigarettes
rows.note: cigarettes (other tobacco products 60% of the invoice price). Unit: per 20 cigarettes.

rows.label: Excise tax: beer and malt beverages
rows.note: beer and malt beverages. Unit: per fluid ounce.

rows.label: Excise tax: distilled spirits
rows.note: distilled alcoholic beverages (wine and sake 5 cents per fluid ounce). Unit: per fluid ounce.

rows.label: Excise tax: soft drinks
rows.note: soft drinks (plus the 5-cent beverage container tax). Unit: per fluid ounce.

rows.label: Fuel tax: liquid fuel
rows.note: first sale or distribution of liquid fuel in the CNMI (aviation fuel 3% ad valorem). Unit: per gallon.

rows.label: Beverage container tax
rows.note: each soft drink or alcoholic beverage container. Unit: per container.

rows.label: Bar tax: alcoholic beverages served on premises
rows.note: total charge for alcoholic beverages sold or consumed in licensed establishments.

rows.label: Hotel occupancy tax
rows.note: amount charged to transient occupants of hotels, motels, apartments, private residences, bed and breakfasts and similar facilities.

sections.title: Freelancers, contractors and the self-employed

rows.label: Self-employed: US self-employment tax
rows.note: net earnings from self-employment (12.4% social security up to $184,500 combined with wages, 2.9% Medicare); bona fide residents of the CNMI pay it to the IRS.

rows.section: Wage and salary tax (Chapter 2): rate on total yearly wages
rows.basis: total yearly wages and salaries for work in the CNMI (Chapter 2 tax); the rate of the bracket applies to the whole amount ("of the amount over $0"), not marginally
rows.note: The wage and salary tax is a nonrefundable credit against the NMTIT on CNMI-source income (Form 1040CM Schedule OS-3405A, Part A; withholding guidelines). The education tax credit (cash contributions to CNMI educational institutions, at most $5,000) reduces it.
rows.source_title: 4 CMC § 1204, Amount of Tax (wage and salary tax and earnings tax)

rows.section: Minimum wage
rows.note: basic minimum rate in the Northern Mariana Islands (the federal minimum wage). Unit: per hour.
rows.label: Minimum wage (Northern Mariana Islands)

rows.section: Corporate income tax
rows.label: Corporate income tax: NMTIT (mirror code) with the CNMI rebate
rows.value: Corporations pay the NMTIT (the US Internal Revenue Code adopted as a local territorial income tax, including its corporate rates) on Form 1120CM, with the rebate offset of 4 CMC § 1708 on CNMI-source income

rows.section: Business gross revenue tax: general business
rows.basis: yearly total gross revenue of a business (general business); the bracket's rate applies to the whole gross revenue ("of the amount over $0"), filed monthly on Form OS-3105
rows.note: The business gross revenue tax is a nonrefundable credit against the owner's NMTIT on CNMI-source income (Schedule OS-3405A). Manufacturers and wholesalers, and agriculture, fishing and registered artists, have their own schedules (4 CMC §§ 1302, 1303).

rows.section: Excise duties
rows.note: first sale, use, manufacture, lease or rental in the CNMI of goods not otherwise provided for (ad valorem), collected on imports.
rows.label: Excise tax: all other goods

rows.section: Excise duties
rows.note: foodstuffs, ad valorem (also agricultural inputs, hygiene products, prescription drugs and goods made in the CNMI at 1%).
rows.label: Excise tax: foodstuffs and other 1% goods

rows.section: Excise duties
rows.note: passenger vehicle with a value not exceeding $30,000 per unit (5.75% above $30,000).
rows.label: Excise tax: passenger vehicles up to $30,000

rows.section: Excise duties
rows.note: cosmetics, ad valorem (perfumery 23%; leather goods, jewellery and precious metals 5.75%; construction materials 3%).
rows.label: Excise tax: cosmetics

rows.section: Excise duties
rows.note: cigarettes (other tobacco products 60% of the invoice price). Unit: per 20 cigarettes.
rows.label: Excise tax: cigarettes

rows.section: Excise duties
rows.note: beer and malt beverages. Unit: per fluid ounce.
rows.label: Excise tax: beer and malt beverages

rows.section: Excise duties
rows.note: distilled alcoholic beverages (wine and sake 5 cents per fluid ounce). Unit: per fluid ounce.
rows.label: Excise tax: distilled spirits

rows.section: Excise duties
rows.note: soft drinks (plus the 5-cent beverage container tax). Unit: per fluid ounce.
rows.label: Excise tax: soft drinks

rows.section: Excise duties
rows.note: first sale or distribution of liquid fuel in the CNMI (aviation fuel 3% ad valorem). Unit: per gallon.
rows.label: Fuel tax: liquid fuel

rows.section: Excise duties
rows.note: each soft drink or alcoholic beverage container. Unit: per container.
rows.label: Beverage container tax

rows.section: Excise duties
rows.note: total charge for alcoholic beverages sold or consumed in licensed establishments.
rows.label: Bar tax: alcoholic beverages served on premises

rows.section: Tourist and accommodation taxes

rows.label: Hotel occupancy tax

rows.source_title: Self-employment tax (Social Security and Medicare taxes)
rows.label: Self-employed: US self-employment tax

rows.section: Freelancers, contractors and the self-employed
rows.note: net earnings from self-employment from which the self-employment tax is due.

rows.label: Self-employed: self-employment tax filing threshold

rows.section: Freelancers, contractors and the self-employed
rows.note: wages, compensation and self-employment income above $200,000 (single, head of household), $250,000 (married filing jointly) or $125,000 (married filing separately).
rows.source_title: Self-employment tax (Social Security and Medicare taxes)
rows.label: Self-employed: Additional Medicare Tax above the threshold

rows.section: Freelancers, contractors and the self-employed

rows.label: Self-employed: social security part capped at $184,500
